# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Literature-backed validation scenario envelopes and executable test suite are complete. docs/validation_scenarios.md documents 8 scenarios (VS-01 through VS-08) covering chemistry (cycling, aeration, pH swing, source-water differentiation, denitrification), ecology (algae-plant competition), and animal behavior (shrimp breeding, stocking crash). Each scenario includes a rationale paragraph, peer-reviewed literature citations (Hovanec & DeLong 1996, Colt 2006, Brewer & Goldman 1976, Stumm & Morgan 1996, Tropea et al. 2015, Tilman 1982, Seitzinger 1988, Timmons & Ebeling 2010), expected qualitative outcomes, confidence rating (high or medium), and envelope bounds. The e2e_validation_suite.rs test file implements all 8 probes with deterministic seeded runs, multi-checkpoint envelope assertions, and a summary runner that reports pass/fail per scenario with confidence tier breakdown. A minor type alias refactor (ProbeFn) in the summary runner improves readability. All 9 tests pass (8 probes + 1 summary), clippy is clean, and formatting is verified.

## Steps

0. [Completed] Explore project structure to understand existing validation infrastructure, harness APIs, scenario definitions, and provenance metadata system
1. [Completed] Read docs/validation_scenarios.md to verify 8 scenarios with literature citations, rationale, expected outcomes, confidence ratings, and envelope bounds
2. [Completed] Read crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs to verify Envelope struct, HarnessRun API, checkpoint/assertion infrastructure, and artifact packaging
3. [Completed] Read full e2e_validation_suite.rs (1405 lines) to verify all 8 probes (VS-01 through VS-08) plus summary runner are implemented with correct envelope assertions
4. [Completed] Run cargo test --test e2e_validation_suite validation_suite_summary to verify all 8 scenarios pass with correct output format (8/8 passed, 6/6 high-confidence, 2/2 medium-confidence)
5. [Completed] Run all 9 individual tests (8 probes + summary) to verify they pass independently
6. [Completed] Run cargo clippy --test e2e_validation_suite -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --check to verify code quality
7. [Completed] Verify acceptance criteria: 8 scenarios >= 6 minimum, literature citations present for all, rationale+outcomes+confidence+bounds per scenario, chemistry/ecology/behavior coverage, directionally-validated vs still-heuristic distinction, reusable envelope definitions, executable pass/fail summary

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test --test e2e_validation_suite: 9 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored (all 8 probes + summary runner)
- validation_suite_summary output: SUMMARY: 8/8 scenarios passed, High-confidence: 6/6 passed, Medium-confidence: 2/2 passed
- VS-01 Cycling timeline PASS: week8 TAN=1.067 NO2=0.002 NO3=7.879 pH=8.500 — nitrogen succession completes within 8 weeks
- VS-02 Aeration effects PASS: aerated DO=8.45 pH=8.330 > passive DO=4.17 pH=6.730 — DO gap=4.28, pH gap=1.600
- VS-03 Day/night pH swing PASS: light_max_pH=7.412 > dark_min_pH=7.308, swing=0.103 within [0.1, 2.0]
- VS-04 Source-water differentiation PASS: hard_shrimp pH=8.257, ro_like pH=6.732, gap=1.525 >= 1.0
- VS-05 Shrimp breeding PASS: cool pop=260 cycles=10 juv=206 vs warm pop=10 juv=0 — thermal suppression directionally correct
- VS-06 Algae-plant competition PASS: plants 8.00g->1.73g, health 0.800->0.000, algae biomass maintained — R* competition confirmed
- VS-07 Nitrate removal PASS: planted N2_export=59.97mg_N denitrifier_act=0.816 vs bare N2_export=0.00 — denitrification pathway active
- VS-08 Stocking density crash PASS: initial=20 final=0 TAN=275.50 NO2=21.69 — total population collapse from overfeeding
- cargo clippy --test e2e_validation_suite -- -D warnings: clean (no warnings)
- cargo fmt --check: clean (no formatting issues)
- docs/validation_scenarios.md has 8 scenarios with confidence summary table distinguishing 'validated directionally' (high) from 'still heuristic' (medium)
- Validation report template at end of docs/validation_scenarios.md ready for G4 calibration workflow auto-population
- Scenario confidence coverage: chemistry (VS-01,02,03,04), microbiology (VS-01,07), ecology (VS-06), animal behavior (VS-05), toxicology/husbandry (VS-08)

## Outstanding Risks

- VS-03 pH swing of 0.103 is at the absolute floor of the [0.1, 2.0] envelope — a minor parameter change could push it below threshold. Consider increasing plant biomass or reducing buffering in the test setup for more headroom.
- VS-06 and VS-07 carry medium confidence — their envelope bounds may need revision as plant growth and denitrification kinetics get better calibration data from G4.
- The validation report template in docs/validation_scenarios.md is a static text format. The G4 calibration workflow (tanksim-6e5.7.4) needs to implement the auto-population logic to produce machine-readable reports.
- No cross-seed robustness check: all probes use a single deterministic seed. A future improvement could run each probe with 3-5 seeds to verify envelope stability.
